usage.outputShape: body.pdf_url (presigned CloudConvert S3 download link, valid ~24h), body.file_size_bytes, body.source_url, body.job_id
quirks: Requires a 'url' field pointing to a remote page; despite the name/description ('Render HTML or a URL'), a raw 'html' field is NOT accepted and returns 400 'Missing or invalid url field' (that call still charges $0.08).
Output pdf_url is a CloudConvert presigned S3 URL with X-Amz-Expires=86400 (~24h) — download promptly, it is not permanent.
x402 pays even on a 400 validation error, so send the correct {url} body the first time.
usage.guide: Call POST https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/html-to-pdf with JSON body {"url":"<page-to-render>"} and pay the $0.08 USDC x402 quote on Base. It renders the remote page to a PDF (via CloudConvert) and returns 200 with body.pdf_url, a presigned S3 download link that expires in ~24h — fetch the PDF from there promptly. Note: only a 'url' is accepted; do not send raw 'html' (it 400s and still costs money).
